baseline: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM learners) AS learners, (SELECT count(*) FROM assessment_sessions) AS assessment_sessions, (SELECT count(*) FROM session_items) AS served_items, (SELECT count(*) FROM answers) AS answers, (SELECT count(*) FROM evaluation_results WHERE status='graded') AS graded_answers, (SELECT count(*) FROM mastery_evidence) AS mastery_evidence, (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_reads) AS lesson_reads, (SELECT count(*) FROM lesson_reads WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS lesson_completions, (SELECT count(*) FROM review_events) AS review_events, (SELECT count(*) FROM review_cards) AS review_cards
first_scored_attempts: WITH ranked AS (SELECT a.learner_id,a.question_id,e.is_correct,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.learner_id,a.question_id ORDER BY a.submitted_at,a.id) AS attempt FROM answers a JOIN evaluation_results e ON e.answer_id=a.id JOIN questions q ON q.id=a.question_id WHERE q.format='single_choice' AND e.status='graded' AND e.method='deterministic_choice') SELECT count(*) AS learner_question_pairs,count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_correct) AS correct,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_correct) AS incorrect FROM ranked WHERE attempt=1
repeated_topic_errors: WITH misses AS (SELECT a.learner_id,q.topic_id,count(*) AS errors,count(DISTINCT a.question_id) AS distinct_questions FROM answers a JOIN evaluation_results e ON e.answer_id=a.id JOIN questions q ON q.id=a.question_id WHERE e.status='graded' AND e.method='deterministic_choice' AND NOT e.is_correct GROUP BY a.learner_id,q.topic_id) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE errors>=2) AS learner_topic_pairs_with_repeated_errors,count(*) FILTER (WHERE errors>=2 AND distinct_questions>=2) AS across_multiple_questions FROM misses
post_completion_attempts: WITH classified AS (SELECT e.is_correct,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lesson_reads lr JOIN lessons l ON l.id=lr.lesson_id WHERE lr.learner_id=a.learner_id AND l.skill_id=q.skill_id AND l.topic_id=q.topic_id AND lr.completed_at<=i.served_at) AS after_completion FROM answers a JOIN session_items i ON i.id=a.session_item_id JOIN questions q ON q.id=a.question_id JOIN evaluation_results e ON e.answer_id=a.id WHERE e.status='graded' AND e.method='deterministic_choice') SELECT after_completion,count(*) AS graded_attempts,count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_correct) AS correct FROM classified GROUP BY after_completion ORDER BY after_completion
exposure: WITH exposure AS (SELECT s.learner_id,i.question_id,count(*) AS served FROM session_items i JOIN assessment_sessions s ON s.id=i.session_id GROUP BY s.learner_id,i.question_id) SELECT coalesce(sum(served),0)::int AS served_items,count(*) AS learner_question_pairs,coalesce(sum(served-1),0)::int AS repeat_serves FROM exposure
first_recorded_assessment_exposure: WITH exposure AS (SELECT i.id,i.question_id,s.learner_id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY s.learner_id,i.question_id ORDER BY i.served_at,i.id) AS ordinal FROM session_items i JOIN assessment_sessions s ON s.id=i.session_id) SELECT count(*) AS graded_first_exposures,count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.is_correct) AS correct FROM exposure x JOIN answers a ON a.session_item_id=x.id JOIN evaluation_results e ON e.answer_id=a.id WHERE x.ordinal=1 AND e.status='graded' AND e.method='deterministic_choice'
review_observations: WITH events AS (SELECT r.*,m.source,m.verified,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY r.learner_id,r.skill_id ORDER BY r.occurred_at,r.id) AS ordinal,lag(r.occurred_at) OVER(PARTITION BY r.learner_id,r.skill_id ORDER BY r.occurred_at,r.id) AS previous FROM review_events r JOIN mastery_evidence m ON m.id=r.evidence_id) SELECT count(*) AS events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ordinal=1) AS initial_events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ordinal>1 AND was_due) AS later_due_events,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ordinal>1 AND was_due AND source='objective_assessment' AND occurred_at-previous>=interval '1 day') AS later_due_objective_at_least_one_day,count(*) FILTER(WHERE ordinal>1 AND was_due AND source='objective_assessment' AND occurred_at-previous>=interval '1 day' AND quality>=3) AS successful_later_due_objective_at_least_one_day FROM events
mastery_states: SELECT state::text,count(*) AS skills_with_state FROM skill_mastery GROUP BY state ORDER BY state
bank_formats: SELECT format::text,count(*) AS active_questions FROM questions WHERE is_active GROUP BY format ORDER BY format
topic_level_coverage: WITH levels AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['beginner','intermediate','advanced']) AS level), cells AS (SELECT t.id,levels.level,count(q.id) AS scored FROM topics t CROSS JOIN levels LEFT JOIN questions q ON q.topic_id=t.id AND q.is_active AND q.format='single_choice' AND q.difficulty::text=levels.level GROUP BY t.id,levels.level) SELECT count(*) AS topic_level_cells,count(*) FILTER(WHERE scored=0) AS empty_scored_cells,count(*) FILTER(WHERE scored<2) AS fewer_than_two_scored FROM cells
